restored.notes: Times are milliseconds except CPU percent, memory MiB and SkippedRenderDeadlines (counts, summed across frames). Scene/layers/FrameWork are nested; do not sum all metrics. PaintDispatch includes WinForms buffer copy, not display scan-out. FrameInterval is WM_PAINT cadence, not proven presentation. FrameWakeLateness is UI callback time minus requested deadline. CPU covers the entire host process. Missing metrics are unavailable, not zero cost.
